title: Lindsay's family and another family band
summary: Asked whether Lindsay's relatives read music, he describes a family band with a young cornet player and violin lead.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Did his father read music, do you think?

His brother, no. No, I played with them too. He had a little fellow playing with him. Joe, what did they have? Joe, we called him Joe. A little bit of a little fellow playing cornet with him. So I went round there and... Jack Fajida. He used to play with the old man, Johnny. Johnny was playing bass. Herbert was playing violin. The old man was playing guitar. Jack Fajida. Jack Fajida. Jack Fajida. He was playing a little bit of a little bit of a... Cornet. Cornet. Yeah, he didn't have no crannets. Let's see. Who was playing, he didn't have no crannets on the blade. They ought to have a lead there.
Oh yeah. Who was playing violin. Oh yeah, so that was a lead. Yeah, it was a lead.
